python -c "
import parse

# Search mode should now stop at space for left/center alignment
p = parse.Parser('{:<}')
print('Left align search on \"hello world\":', p.search('hello world'))

p2 = parse.Parser('{:^}')
print('Center align search on \"hello world\":', p2.search('hello world'))

# Right alignment should still work (uses lazy .+?)
p3 = parse.Parser('{:>}')
print('Right align search on \"hello world\":', p3.search('hello world'))

# With context, it should work correctly
p4 = parse.Parser('{:<} world')
print('Left align with context:', p4.search('hello       world'))

p5 = parse.Parser('{:>} world')  
print('Right align with context:', p5.search('hello       world'))
"
